description_good: README.md (Vietnamese) and README.en.md describe what Tsu Contact does: convert CSV contact lists to vCard (.vcf) for phones, fully offline: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/README.en.md
interact: README.en.md and CONTRIBUTING.md explain how to obtain the source and binaries, report bugs (issue forms), request features and contribute: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the pull request process: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the requirements: tests for every change, ruff with zero warnings, pytest, Conventional Commits, hash-pinned Apache-2.0-compatible dependencies: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_basics: README.en.md covers installation (winget, Scoop, installer), usage and verification; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md covers the design: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
documentation_interface: The program is a desktop GUI; README.en.md documents its inputs (CSV columns, encodings, delimiters) and output (vCard 3.0 file): https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/README.en.md
sites_https: Project site https://contact.tsudev.com and the GitHub repository/releases are HTTPS only (HTTP redirects with 301).
discussion: GitHub Issues are public and searchable: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/issues
english: English documentation and bug reports are accepted: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/README.en.md
maintained: Actively maintained: release 26.11.1601 on 16/11/2026 and regular commits: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/commits/main
repo_track: Git tracks every change with author and date.
repo_interim: Work in progress is pushed to branches and pull requests between releases.
version_unique: Each release has a unique version and git tag: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/tags
version_semver: Calendar Versioning: YY.M.DD plus a two-digit build number (e.g. 26.11.1601), monotonic and Windows file-version compatible.
version_tags: Every release is tagged (v26.8.2002, v26.11.1001, v26.11.1601): https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/tags
release_notes: CHANGELOG.md summarises every release in human-readable form: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns: No publicly known vulnerability has been fixed in any release so far.
report_process: Bug reports use GitHub Issues with an issue form: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/issues/new/choose
report_responses: No external bug report has been filed so far; the maintainer reads every issue and acknowledges reports within days.
enhancement_responses: No external enhancement request has been filed so far; the feature request form routes them to the maintainer, who answers each one.
report_archive: GitHub Issues are public and searchable: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process: SECURITY.md explains how to report vulnerabilities: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response: No vulnerability report was received in the last 6 months. SECURITY.md commits to a reply within 7 days and a fix for critical issues within 30 days.
build: scripts/build-win.ps1 builds the Windows executable with PyInstaller from tsucontact.spec; the release workflow runs it on GitHub Actions: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/.github/workflows/build-release-win.yml
build_common_tools: pip with hash-pinned requirements and PyInstaller.
build_floss_tools: Python, pip, pytest, ruff and PyInstaller are all FLOSS.
test: An automated pytest suite (53 test functions, Hypothesis property tests for the CSV parser and vCard writer) is in tests/: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/tree/main/tests
test_most: Tests cover CSV input handling (encodings, delimiters, size and field limits, CSV-injection-safe report), vCard generation, settings/i18n and the full GUI flow (tests/test_ui.py: load CSV, map columns, filter, export): https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/tree/main/tests
test_continuous_integration: GitHub Actions runs lint and tests on Linux and Windows for every push and pull request: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_policy: CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests for every new feature or bug fix: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added: Recent changes added tests together with the code, e.g. the input limits and settings validation listed in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 5: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
tests_documented_added: The test policy is written in CONTRIBUTING.md: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings: ruff (pycodestyle, pyflakes, bugbear, bandit security rules, pyupgrade, isort, simplify) runs in CI: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/ruff.toml
warnings_fixed: CI fails on any ruff finding; the main branch has zero warnings.
warnings_strict: ruff runs with a broad rule set including the bandit security rules (S) and fails the build on any warning.
know_secure_design: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 5 documents the threat model and defences: data only in RAM, no network code at all, defensive CSV parsing with size limits, CSV-injection-safe reports, strict settings validation: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
know_common_errors: The common errors for this kind of program and their mitigations are documented with the test that guards each (resource exhaustion, CSV/formula injection, vCard field injection, leftover personal data on disk, tampered settings): https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
crypto_published: The application performs no cryptography and opens no network connection.
crypto_pfs: The application opens no network connection.
crypto_random: The application generates no keys or nonces.
delivery_mitm: Releases are downloaded over HTTPS from GitHub; SHA256SUMS.txt is signed with Sigstore and the build has GitHub artifact attestation (gh attestation verify).
delivery_unsigned: Hashes are published in a Sigstore-signed SHA256SUMS.txt over HTTPS, never over plain HTTP.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days: No unpatched vulnerability of medium or higher severity: 0 open Dependabot and code scanning alerts; pip-audit runs in CI on every change.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed: No critical vulnerability has been reported; Dependabot and pip-audit keep dependencies patched.
no_leaked_credentials: gitleaks scans every push and pull request in CI: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
static_analysis: ruff (including the bandit security rules) and GitHub CodeQL (Python, Actions) analyse every change.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities: CodeQL security queries and ruff's bandit rules (S) look for common vulnerabilities.
static_analysis_fixed: There are no open code scanning alerts.
static_analysis_often: Static analysis runs on every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis: Hypothesis property-based tests feed thousands of random inputs to the CSV parser and vCard writer in CI: https://github.com/tsudev-org/tsucontact/tree/main/tests
dynamic_analysis_unsafe: The program is written in Python, a memory-safe language.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions: The property tests assert the safety invariants (size limits, escaping, round-trip) on every generated input.
dynamic_analysis_fixed: No medium or higher severity issue found by dynamic analysis remains unfixed.
